consequence.statement: Loki won't start if structured metadata is enabled (the new default) and the schema is not tsdb with v13.
consequence.remediation: Use tsdb index and v13 schema, or see the referenced Structured Metadata, Schemas and Indexes section.

assertion.statement: Structured metadata is now enabled by default and requires tsdb index and v13 schema, otherwise Loki won't start.

proposal.undeterminedReason: change: text says enabled by default but does not name the config key or before/after values; applicability: schema_config contents and structured-metadata setting are not specified in evidence in a way that yields a precise predicate
